linear.scope: Public homepage, desktop 1280×720 and mobile 390×844. Public source and live DOM; no FPS or compositor trace.
linear.framework: React, Motion components / values / springs / shared layout, CSS transitions and keyframes, native scrolling.
linear.counting: 14 teaching studies, not 14 total animation instances. Hidden responsive copies and per-dot keyframes are not separate concepts.

purpose.trigger: Transparent SVG stroke hit areas; lower layers at or before selected index lift; mask copies must move too.

featurePanel.mobile: Feature pill row hidden at <=640px on inspected homepage. Shared drawer code exists but is not an exposed mobile homepage interaction.

chart.indexNote: Each cluster uses index 20×clusterIndex+pointIndex; groups overlap, not one global serial ordering. Percentile paths are static.

slack.trigger: Click Send message with prefilled mock command; local React state, not a message to Slack.

ai.scroll: ResizeObserver scrolls chat to scrollHeight; behavior smooth unless isStatic. Browser scroll duration is not specified.

review.themePicker: 8 themes; hover/focus preview. Content and theme swap through state/CSS variables, no crossfade found.

carousel.duration: Touch/wheel gesture and snapping are browser-defined. Shared arrow helper animates scroll position with stiffness100/damping20, not browser smooth scrolling.
carousel.scopeNote: No carousel arrow controls exposed in the inspected mobile homepage DOM; the showcase supplies study-only arrows.

motionPolicy.hero: Once per route/key; reduced-motion or hash navigation skips initial hidden state; first scroll cancels intro gating.
motionPolicy.grid: Source CSS loader animations are infinite, including hidden copies; not all loops are viewport-gated.
motionPolicy.ai: Active at viewport +400px; source settles rows for reduced-motion and prevents cycling.
motionPolicy.chart: Reduced-motion shows dots and removes animation.
motionPolicy.marquee: Animation is inside no-preference media query.
motionPolicy.momentum: No local reduced-motion branch in this component; showcase adds one.

instrument.scope: Homepage, desktop 1280/1440px and narrow 390px viewport in a fine-pointer browser. True touch hardware and OS reduced-motion behavior were not emulated.

entrance.reducedMotion: Durations set to0; explicit timeline positions remain.

reveals.repeat: Each IntersectionObserver unobserves its target on first entry.
reveals.reducedMotion: The helper does not initialize hidden/split states when noMotionPreference is false.

purpose.lineDelays: Determined by each line entering the observer boundary, not fixed offsets between lines.

filters.order: Fade old cards; change active grid after old batch completes; fade new cards.
filters.layout: Discrete grid replacement, no FLIP position tween found.

abacus.firstAppearance: Set target geometry immediately, then fade opacity.
abacus.interruption: anime.remove cancels prior tween before replacement.

header.hideCondition: positive sampled delta, past header height, menu closed
header.showCondition: sampled delta < -15px or scroll top; mouse entering top header region can also recover it

announcement.interval: CMS marquee_time, not extracted from the delivered component; no numeric interval claimed.
announcement.pause: mouseenter stops timer; mouseleave restarts it; touch toggles.

rotators.assignment: source item index modulo column count

slideshow.transitionEvidence: No component speed override; delivered Swiper default speed is 300ms.
slideshow.pause: Swiper autoplay pause/resume plus paused CSS progress
slideshow.reduced: Autoplay-start handler attempts a stop through a different ref path; actual reduced-motion result not verified.

mobileMenu.reduced: No preference guard in the menu tween handlers.

micro.siblingDimCondition: card-grid__cards--dim when item count<5 and parent has no no-hover flag
micro.imageHoverReducedMotion: Guarded by no-preference; sibling dimming and button rules are not equivalently guarded.

video.ambient: Vimeo poster loop; IntersectionObserver loads and plays visible media, pauses offscreen.
video.reel: Separate iframe shown on click; poster/play icon fade away.
video.touch: Square ambient poster and requested fullscreen; CSS probe at x=-9999. Fine pointer switches to landscape variant and x=-9998.
video.reduced: Ambient automatic play is gated by noMotionPreference; manual playback remains.
video.playIconHover: A .95→1 scale150ms rule exists, but pointer-events:none and no parent-hover trigger were found; excluded as a verified active effect.

cookie.reduced: No local preference guard in transition CSS.

stack: Base UI dialogs, drawer and menu primitives
Sanity content and native HTML video
audit.versionPolicy: No package versions inferred from hashed filenames.

title.mask: Per-word overflow-hidden wrapper; 0.14em bottom padding + negative margin preserve descenders

support.ease: Motion easeOut; CSS ease-out cubic(0,0,.58,1) for these opacity tweens

hero.trigger: Component mount, not viewport entry or scroll progress

header.logic: Compact once y>24; remain compact until y<4. Initial mount directly tests y>24. Header stays fixed.
header.compactBackground: Fill opacity rises to 0.3; header backdrop-blur-lg =16px.
header.coverDetection: Each marked hero rect top<header height and bottom>0, recomputed on scroll/resize.

mega.motion: Opacity only in the inspected markup; transition lists transform but no changing transform endpoint
mega.trigger: Desktop hover or focus on navigation point; close on pointer leave, blur outside header, Escape, route change
mega.content: Active nav content conditionally rendered. On close the content is removed immediately while container opacity transitions. No item stagger.

products.behavior: Contained studio image replaced by cropped lifestyle image. No scale tween here.
products.badges: Shared-layout spring badge expansion is bundled, but no homepage feature badges were observed; excluded from active inventory.

gallery.speedUnits: 0.5px per 1000/60ms simulation step =30px/s steady state; render interpolation between steps
gallery.interaction: Pointer down stops automatic movement; after pointer up it waits for settle and restarts. Focus stops; focusout restarts.
gallery.layout: Cropped natural aspect ratio on desktop; 3:4 tiles below 768px. Continuous loop with slide recycling, not CSS translate(-50%).
gallery.reducedMotion: No guard in this homepage gallery component. A separate product-page carousel has one, but is outside this audit.
gallery.visibility: No viewport-gated start/stop in the component; motion was observed while offscreen.

overlap.mapping: Linear, clamped interpolation of live scroll progress; no fixed duration or ease curve
overlap.reducedMotion: useReducedMotion returns undefined transforms, preserving static layout

rows.snap: x proximity; children snap-start; custom scroll-padding
rows.resize: ResizeObserver recalculates overflow; scroll state updates in requestAnimationFrame
rows.responsive: Articles below 768px become a static vertical list of the first four entries. References retain native horizontal scrolling. Navigation buttons are hidden for coarse pointers.

footer.visibility: No viewport gate in these CSS animations

mobile.lifecycle: Base UI Dialog; portal keepMounted. Escape closes; Back restores root. Icon/content swaps are discrete. No link cascade.

drawer.swipe: Direct displacement, transition disabled while swiping. Release duration follows swipe strength. Physical touch swipe not tested.
drawer.usedBy: Search and floating help / project controls

placeholder.lifecycle: AnimatePresence overlaps outgoing and incoming strings. Query text hides placeholder; reduced motion selects a static first string and skips interval.

help.footerTrigger: IntersectionObserver on data-site-footer. Closed launcher hides while footer intersects.

video.element: Native video, loop, muted, playsInline, preload=metadata; Vimeo progressive media URL
video.start: Imperative play() on effect unless prefers-reduced-motion matches; rejected play promises are ignored
video.visibility: No pause observer in AmbientVideo; all three paused:false while far above viewport in live inspection
video.osChange: Preference read at effect time; no preference-change subscription in that component
video.contentBoundary: Object movement, camera edits and morphs inside video are not DOM animations. No remote videos downloaded.
